name: Koganei
source:
A platypus (female) that for some reason has taken up residence in the court. No one knows where she came from.

She is popular and liked by everyone. She likes to play the hero.

She is very attached to Juliette. Even if bad guys come, she will beat them up!

[From [url=http://www.teck.co.jp/gj/products/q_bon/chara/gense.html]official site[/url]]
